transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
Honestly, HR and my sister have been on me because they think I’ve gotten too thin. I mean, my weight has kept dropping since the divorce, but from my perspective my suits just fit sharper.
Do you feel overweight?
I don’t know if I’d say overweight exactly, but when I look in the mirror, I focus on my stomach and face. If I look soft at all, I feel like people will see me as sloppy or weak.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah. If the scale is even a pound up after a client dinner or a weekend out in Miami, I panic a little. It feels like I’m losing control, and I immediately start figuring out how to cut back the next day.
Have you been deliberately eating less to keep your weight down?

Yeah. Most days it’s just coffee in the morning, maybe a protein bar between calls, then something small at night—like grilled chicken without rice. If I eat a full meal, it feels like I’ve messed up the whole day.
What is your current weight?
Honestly, I’m here because HR and my sister keep saying I’ve gotten too thin. My weight’s been dropping since the divorce, but I mostly just notice that my suits fit sharper.
What is your current weight?
Honestly, I don’t know the exact number. HR and my sister say I’ve gotten too thin, and I know my weight’s kept dropping since the divorce, but I mostly just notice my suits fitting sharper.
What is your height?
I’m not sure of my exact height. I guess… HR and my sister are more focused on me getting too thin; I’ve mostly just noticed my suits fitting sharper since the divorce.
Do you feel that your current weight is too low?
I mean, people keep saying I’m too thin, but I’m still jogging, working my territory, hitting my numbers. It doesn’t feel like a medical emergency to me.
When you look at yourself in the mirror, do you see yourself as still too fat?
Yeah, sometimes. Before a meeting or a date, I’ll look at my stomach and my face and think I look soft. Then I worry people will see me as sloppy or weak.
Have you fainted?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly—like fully passing out? I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Has a doctor ever told you that you are underweight?
No doctor has said it directly. HR and my sister keep telling me I’ve gotten too thin, but I just see my suits fitting sharper. My weight’s been dropping since the divorce.
Do you believe you need to lose more weight?

I mean, if the scale goes up even a pound after a client dinner or a weekend in Miami, I panic a little. It feels like I’m losing control, and I immediately start figuring out how to cut back the next day.
Has your weight become so low that other people would say you look underweight?
Yeah, that’s what HR and my sister keep telling me—that I’ve gotten too thin. I don’t really see it that way, though. My suits just fit sharper, and my weight’s been dropping since the divorce.
Has your interest in sex decreased?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change in that.
Did the weight loss start because you were trying to get thinner?

Yeah, I was trying to get thinner. Most days I keep it to coffee in the morning, maybe a protein bar between calls, then something small at night—like grilled chicken without rice. If I eat a full meal, it feels like I’ve messed up the whole day.
